# Cheyenne, Wyoming public meetings record (plain text)

> An AI-readable mirror of {{stat:meetings}} public meetings of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming (and some Laramie County boards), {{stat:years}}. It has {{stat:documents}} archived agendas, packets, supporting documents, and minutes as plain Markdown, plus timestamped transcripts of 2026 meetings linked to the official video, and {{stat:caption_transcripts}} caption transcripts of meeting videos from 2017–2026 ({{stat:caption_words}} words). No JavaScript or PDFs are needed. Each meeting is at meetings/<YEAR>/<body>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.html (or .md).

Body slugs: city-council, finance-committee, public-services-committee, work-sessions, planning-commission, board-of-adjustment, historic-preservation-board, urban-renewal-authority, board-of-county-commissioners.
Every page is also available as Markdown at the same path with a .md extension.
Keyword counts are search aids, not findings. Transcripts are auto-captions: names and numbers may be misheard, so check against the linked video.

## Start here
- [Home](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/index.html): what is here, how to navigate, how to cite
- [Meeting catalog (JSON)](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/indexes/meetings.json): every meeting with URLs, document counts, official links, and keyword counts
- [Keyword index](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/indexes/keywords.html): annexation, data centers, Microsoft, Chapter 1.28 warrants, referendum, sixth penny, sole source, Ardurra, Musco, and more, by meeting
- [Caption transcripts](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/indexes/caption-transcripts.html): every meeting-video caption transcript in the WindyCityMeetings database, by date, linked to its meeting page
- [Wyoming statute citations](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/indexes/statutes.html): every W.S. citation found, by meeting
- [Ordinance numbers](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/indexes/ordinances.html): ordinance numbers from the Records of Proceedings

## Verified topics
- [Chapter 1.28 administrative inspection warrants](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/topics/chapter-1-28-administrative-inspection-warrants.html): readings, amendments, votes, Ordinance 4656
- [Charles Miller public comment record, 2026](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/topics/charles-miller-public-comment-record.html): verbatim anchors with timestamps and outcomes
- [Corrections](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/topics/corrections.html): errors earlier AI answers made about this record
- [Data quality](https://bartimoussmith-oss.github.io/therealwindycity/topics/data-quality.html): scanned pages, failed captures, caption alias table
